RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: cannot responsibly be quantified from these facts

An all-male panel is worth raising as a procedural concern, but it does not establish sex discrimination. Your PhD and eight years’ leadership experience are substantial; however, the role may legitimately prioritize broader management experience over academic qualifications.

Follow up in writing requesting the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, reasons for choosing the successful candidate, and the panel-composition policy. You can neutrally ask how fairness and potential bias were addressed.

Whether the panel composition breaches any rule—and whether two weeks exceeds a response deadline—depends on the jurisdiction and hospital. Check complaint deadlines now with your union or an equality adviser; don’t assume waiting for an explanation pauses them.
